incentives.name: Sales tax exemption for datacenter computer equipment
incentives.what: Exempts computers, equipment, hardware and software for a certified datacenter at one SC location investing at least $50M over five years (or $75M in aggregate by several taxpayers) and creating and keeping 25 full-time jobs paying 150% of state or county per capita income for three years; certification before Jan. 1, 2032.

incentives.name: Sales tax exemption for computer equipment at technology-intensive facilities
incentives.what: Exempts computer equipment for a facility investing at least $300M over five years with 100+ new jobs and at least 60% of investment in computer equipment.

laws_and_bills.name: S. 902 Data Center Siting Act
laws_and_bills.what: Sponsors Rankin and Devine. PSC certificate required before a data center operates; tiers by connected load; efficiency, water, noise and light standards; ratepayer protections; decommissioning assurance; fines up to $50,000/day. Referred to Senate Judiciary Feb. 10, 2026; no further action.

laws_and_bills.name: S. 867 Data Center Development Act
laws_and_bills.what: Sponsor Sen. Tom Davis and nine others. Creates a Data Center Development Office in the Department of Environmental Services; state permit before any data center of 1 MW+ operates, three tiers by load; water efficiency, noise, light and vibration rules; buffers from refuges and critical habitat; PSC must make utilities' data center contracts cover their own costs; decommissioning assurance; fines up to $50,000/day. Introduced Jan. 29, 2026; reported favorably by Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Apr. 28, 2026; no floor vote before the session ended.

laws_and_bills.name: H. 3309 South Carolina Energy Security Act (Act No. 41)
laws_and_bills.what: Broad energy law signed May 12, 2025 (Santee Cooper-Dominion Canadys gas plant, joint resources, economic development rates). Lets utilities give economic development rates to 'transformational customers' (50 MW+ at one point of delivery, 500 jobs, $100M) if the PSC finds no cross-subsidy. Data center limits the Senate added in April 2025 are not in the enacted text, which does not use the term 'data center'.

laws_and_bills.name: Budget proviso on data center sales tax breaks (2026 session)
laws_and_bills.what: After a failed Senate amendment by Sen. Chip Campsen to suspend data center sales tax exemptions for a year (Apr. 23, 2026), a reporting requirement was put in the state budget: the Department of Revenue must report the total value of the breaks to the House and Senate budget chairs. Corrected figure for the year ending June 2025: about $828,000.

dockets.what: Concerned Citizens of Spartanburg County and Southern Alliance for Clean Energy v. Valara Holdings: asked the PSC to review the on-site gas plant (about 450-460 MW) under the Utility Siting Act and halt construction. PSC ruled unanimously Aug. 27, 2026 that the Act does not apply because no power is exported to the grid; rehearing petition filed Sept. 24, 2026, Valara response Oct. 2, taken up Oct. 8, 2026.

dockets.utility: Duke Energy Carolinas, Duke Energy Progress, Dominion Energy South Carolina, Lockhart Power and others
dockets.what: Generic docket for comments on large load additions (50 MW or more): rate schedules, service rules, line extensions, interconnection. Opened May 27, 2026, as required by Duke settlements; Dominion agreed in its rate case settlement to join. Reply comments filed Oct. 15, 2026 by Duke, Dominion, Lockhart, Nucor, Sierra Club and conservation groups.
Dominion retail electric rate increase case. Settlement says Dominion will join the large load (50 MW+) generic docket set up in the Duke settlements.

dockets.utility: Santee Cooper and Dominion Energy South Carolina
dockets.what: Joint application for a certificate to build an advanced combined cycle gas plant at Canadys (about 2,200 MW). Utility CEOs told senators data centers drive 65-70% of future demand.

dockets.utility: Duke Energy Progress (2025-154-E) and Duke Energy Carolinas (2025-172-E, the companion Duke rate case)
dockets.what: Duke's 2025 South Carolina rate cases. Each settled with a separate 'Large Load Stipulation' (DEP's filed 2025-10-27) covering new loads of 50 MW or more: the parties agreed to jointly ask for a generic docket on minimum contract terms, contract demand billing, collateral, exit rules and interconnection cost sharing. The PSC approved the stipulations by Order Nos. 2025-757 and 2025-769; that commitment produced generic docket 2026-138-E.

local_rules.what: Digital infrastructure overlay district allowing data centers and battery storage on certain parcels
County said it would not consider more property tax incentives for data centers until the state passes a law regulating them
Six-month data center moratorium while the county reconsiders zoning rules

local_rules.what: One-year moratorium on new data centers; covers pending applications not yet finalized; can be extended by council; staff to study suitable areas
local_rules.status: first vote unanimous, June 2026; final vote expected September 2026 (not confirmed)

local_rules.what: County zoning officials denied LightHouse's appeal to build a 200,000 sq ft data center on 150 acres near I-85
Data center pause ordinance, taken up after council voted down selling county industrial park land to a data center developer
